notes: ROUTR is a fixed-supply OpenZeppelin ERC-20 named ROUTR with symbol ROUTR and 18 decimals. Its constructor takes no arguments and mints the entire 1,000,000,000-token supply (10^27 base units) once to msg.sender, the deploying factory, emitting a single Transfer from the zero address. The token has no fees, burns, rebases, transfer restrictions, owner or administrator roles, upgrade path, mint entry point, or post-deployment initialization, so all launch distributions arrive whole and no privileged call can move or freeze a holder's balance. No application contracts are deployed for this launch.
